User Story: As a shopper, I want to browse groceries by category so that I can find items for my household.
As a shopper, I want to search groceries by name so that I can find a specific item quickly.
As a shopper, I want to filter for in-stock items so that I can avoid unavailable products.
As a shopper, I want to view item price, pack size, and availability so that I can choose the correct grocery product.
As a shopper, I want to add an in-stock grocery item to my cart so that I can purchase it at checkout.
As a shopper, I want to change the quantity of an item in my cart so that I can adjust my grocery order.
As a shopper, I want to select an available delivery slot so that I can receive groceries at a convenient time.
As a shopper, I want to pay for my grocery order securely so that I can confirm my purchase.
As a shopper, I want to view the current status of my grocery order so that I know its delivery progress.
As a shopper, I want to view the assigned delivery partner’s latest reported location so that I can anticipate arrival.
As a shopper, I want to receive a notification when my order is out for delivery so that I can prepare to receive it.
As a shopper, I want to view past delivery status updates for an order so that I can review its progress.
